Class WaitingRoomViewController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.client.view.gui.controllers.WaitingRoomViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewController
public class WaitingRoomViewController extends Object implements ViewController
The waiting room view controller is represented. Current players are displayed while the game start is awaited.
